concept.title: Pictures from a website
concept.shortdesc: A tree can point to a picture on a website, and asks that website for it.

conbody.p: A tree from another program can point to a picture on a website, rather than hold it. To show the picture, asks that website for it.

section.title: What the website sees
section.p: The website sees your device's internet address and which picture was asked for. It also sees that asked, and which version. Nothing else about you is sent. Nobody who makes sees the request.

section.title: Where the picture is kept
section.p: keeps the picture with the other pictures of your tree. After that, it shows even when your device is not online.
It is kept as the rest of your tree is. So copies that your device makes of your tree include it. says more about those copies.

section.title: If the picture does not come
section.p: If the website does not send the picture, a frame shows in its place. It says that the picture is missing, and why. Choose the frame to try again.
